description: This file defines the class `nusoap_wsdlcache` responsible for caching WSDL instances in the NuSOAP PHP library. It includes methods for creating cache filenames, storing, retrieving, and removing cached WSDL objects, as well as managing file mutexes to prevent race conditions. Additionally, it contains class documentation and some legacy compatibility aliasing.
external_files: php's core functions (file, fopen, fclose, unlink, serialize, unserialize, flock, file)

classes.name: nusoap_wsdlcache
classes.description: Class responsible for caching WSDL instances with methods for create, retrieve, store, and delete cache entries, along with mutex handling to ensure thread safety.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes cache directory and lifetime settings.

methods.name: createFilename
methods.description: Generates a filename for caching a specific WSDL URL.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Appends debug information to the class debug string.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached WSDL object if available and not expired.

methods.name: obtainMutex
methods.description: Obtains a file lock to prevent concurrent cache access.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a WSDL object into the cache.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a cached WSDL file from the cache directory.
